scope: Metadata only: BuildManifest files for the target product type and two reference families. No IPSW was downloaded in this step. No image was decrypted or extracted in this step.
method: Each BuildManifest was parsed as a plist. Every BuildIdentity was enumerated. Components were classified by exact name or by the substring "exclave" in the name or path. Monitor tokens were read from SPTM file paths. Digests are the manifest-recorded SHA-384 values.

classification_rules.exclave: name or path contains "exclave" (case-insensitive), or name is Ap,cL4 or Ap,RestorecL4
classification_rules.coprocessor: known coprocessor firmware names and Rap, or SE, prefixes (naming only; not a functional claim)

limitations: Manifest-level metadata only. Presence of a component name is not evidence that the component runs, is signed for use, or is enabled on a device.
Absence of an exclave-named component in a manifest is not proof that the component is absent from the device or from the firmware image set.
The monitor token in a file name is not, by itself, an authoritative chip identifier. The manifest ApChipID field is recorded separately and is not mapped to a marketing name here.
Only three BuildIdentities per manifest were enumerated. Other restore paths, if any, are outside the manifest data inspected.
Coprocessor names are recorded as names only. Their functions are not inferred.

public_source_observations.method: Repository code search results (count and path only); no function-level review.

string_observations.method: Counts of case-insensitive matches in decompressed local copies of the public payloads. Identifier names are not published.
string_observations.interpretation_limit: Static string presence only. Not evidence of enabled or functional exclave code on any device.
